sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head nearly circular, wider than long; antennae only 14-segmented, segment 3 the shortest, segment 4 as long as segment 2; fontanelle very small, circular, slightly convex, about level with the lower margin of the compound eye; ocelli oval, about their short diameter from the compound eye; postclypeus weakly inflated, without a median line; pronotum nearly oval, anterior margin weakly concave, median notch indistinct. Soldier head pear-shaped, longer than wide, the anterior part narrowed to half the maximum width, fontanelle large, almost at the base of the labrum.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head chestnut brown; antennae, labrum, pronotum and body paler than the head. Head sparsely hairy, pronotum and body densely hairy, wing scales with a few longer hairs. Head nearly circular, wider than long, the frontal surface weakly inclined forwards; fontanelle very small, circular, slightly convex, about level with the lower margin of the compound eye; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 short, segment 3 the shortest, segment 4 as long as segment 2; compound eyes nearly circular, large; ocelli oval, about their short diameter from the compound eye; postclypeus weakly inflated, without a median line; labrum wider than long, with setae near the apical margin and on the body, sides and apex nearly rounded; mandibles of the typical Coptotermes type. Pronotum nearly oval, slightly narrower than the head capsule, wider than long, anterior margin weakly concave with an indistinct median notch, posterior margin with a median concavity. Measurements (mm): body length with wings 10.30—14.00; body length without wings 5.00—5.10; head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.07—1.08; head width including the eyes 1.30—1.32; head height 0.57—0.58; postclypeus length 0.05—0.07, width 0.50—0.52; labrum length 0.35—0.37, width 0.40—0.41; maximum eye diameter 0.35; maximum ocellus diameter 0.125—0.127; eye—ocellus distance 0.03—0.05; eye—antenna distance 0.02—0.04; pronotum length 0.70—0.72, width 1.10—1.11; antennae 14-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head light brown; antennae, legs, pronotum and labrum much paler than the head. Head with a few erect setae, thorax sparsely hairy, abdomen densely hairy. Head pear-shaped, longer than wide, the anterior part narrowed to almost half the maximum width; fontanelle large, almost at the base of the labrum; eyes and ocelli absent; antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length; labrum nearly triangular, longer than wide, the tip transparent and slightly pointed, with 2 setae near the tip; mandibles sabre-shaped. Postmentum rod-like, long and narrow, with a few short hairs anteriorly, widest in the anterior third, narrowest in the posterior third, the maximum width about one and a half times the minimum width. Pronotum flat, nearly kidney-shaped, much wider than long, anterior margin broadly concave with a rather deep median notch, anterolateral corners narrowly rounded, posterior margin with a weak median concavity. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.20—1.25; maximum head width 1.00—1.02; anterior head width 0.50; labrum length 0.25—0.27, width 0.20—0.25; mandible length 0.70—0.73; postmentum midlength 0.70—0.73, maximum width 0.37—0.39, waist width 0.25—0.26; pronotum length 0.40—0.43, width 0.75; antennae 14-segmented.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Material examined: 2 alates and 6 soldiers from Amani (Usambara), Tanzania, syntypes (collected by H. Kirby, 1921-12-21). Type locality: Amani, Usambara, Tanganyika.
